page:
Integration with Vercel AI SDK for response streaming. Elysia supports continuous streaming of ReadableStream and Response. Can return streams directly from AI SDKs. Example models: openai('gpt-5'). Works with streamText from 'ai' package. Supports textStream and toUIMessageStream().
Questions: How do you integrate with AI SDKs? What streaming methods are available? Which models are supported?

sections.manifest:
Response streaming with ReadableStream and Response. Return stream.textStream or stream.toUIMessageStream() directly. Elysia handles stream automatically. Example from ai SDK: streamText with model, system, prompt. Automatic stream handling regardless of type.
Questions: How do you stream responses from AI? What are textStream and toUIMessageStream?

Server-Sent Events for streaming via `sse` function. Wraps ReadableStream with sse(stream). Each chunk sent as SSE event. Works with textStream and toUIMessageStream(). Automatically formats as SSE.
Questions: How do you use SSE with AI streams?

Direct response return for type-unsafe streams. stream.toTextStreamResponse() or stream.toUIMessageStreamResponse() (uses SSE). When type safety not needed with Eden, use these methods. Returns Web Standard Response directly.
Questions: When should you use toTextStreamResponse?

Manual streaming control via async generator function. Syntax: `async function* () { for await (const data of stream.textStream) yield ... }`. Yields sse({ data, event: 'message' }). Full control over chunk handling. Final yield: `sse({ event: 'done' })`.
Questions: How do you manually control streaming?

Fetch for unsupported models. Use native fetch to make requests to AI APIs when SDK doesn't support model. Example OpenAI endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions. POST with Content-Type: application/json. Requires Authorization header with Bearer token from OPENAI_API_KEY. Stream response directly. Elysia proxies with streaming support.
Questions: How do you stream from unsupported models? What headers are needed for OpenAI?
